notes: Kiloview's own product/spec pages (kiloview.com) returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches, so the primary source used was the Kiloview N40 User Manual as mirrored on ManualsLib, cross-checked against mediacastsys.com (authorized reseller spec table) and multiple other retailer listings (Avacab, ProFlix, CDM Technologies), which agreed on all ports. Key finding: the N40 has TWO separate USB Type-C ports — one dedicated to power input (DC 5-18V, nominal 5V/2A, also accepts PoE/USB/power-bank/camera-battery power) and one 'Expansion' port used with a USB-to-serial (RS232/422/485) adapter for PTZ control; neither is a general-purpose USB host/data port, so no USB grade was set (power port omitted grade entirely; expansion port likewise, since it's a control breakout, not a data link). No dedicated RS232/DIN/GPIO physical connector exists — serial control is only reachable via the USB-C expansion port plus an external adapter. A physical tally light and 1/4-20 camera mounting screw exist but are not signal/power connectors so were excluded from the port list. Device is a compact 100x80x24mm handheld unit (not rack-mountable), so rackUnits is omitted. HDMI is confirmed as version 2.0 (supports true 4Kp60) per multiple sources. Ethernet speed confirmed as Gigabit (10/100/1000M) with PoE. Note: encode and decode functions are mutually exclusive (cannot run simultaneously) — this affects how the two HDMI ports behave but not their physical existence. A newer "N40 Plus" variant exists with additional features (LCD display) — this spec is for the base N40 only.

ports.name: HDMI OUT
ports.note: Loop-through output when encoding, or decoded NDI-to-HDMI output when decoding; encode/decode functions are mutually exclusive

ports.name: Audio (3.5mm mic/headset)
ports.note: 3.5mm jack for mic input / intercom headset; supports embedded audio and talkback

ports.name: Ethernet (PoE)
ports.note: 10/100/1000M Ethernet, carries NDI stream, control, and PoE power

ports.name: Power Input (TYPE-C)
ports.note: DC power input via USB-C, DC 5-18V wide range (nominal 5V/2A); can be powered by USB, power bank, or camera battery. Not a data/host USB port.

ports.name: Expansion (TYPE-C)
ports.note: USB-C expansion port used with a USB-to-RS232/RS422/RS485 adapter for PTZ camera control
